summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 12, 2026, announcing its subsidiary Hydro One Networks’ application to the Ontario Energy Board for approval to construct the Durham Kawartha Power Line, a 55-km double-circuit 230-kV transmission line in Ontario, Canada. The project has an estimated cost of ~$430 million and is expected to be in service by 2029. First Nations will have an opportunity for a 50% equity stake through Hydro One’s partnership model. This is a routine regulatory filing for infrastructure investment, not a special situation. No change of control, acquisition, or divestiture is involved.
